_comment: The minimum Story Studio version a freshly shipped Store pack may require. This is the single source of truth: `npm run content-pack:ship` reads min_app_version from here and substitutes it for the {{MIN_APP_VERSION}} token in each pack.json. It is owner-editable data, not a constant in code. Raise it only when a new pack genuinely needs an app capability older builds lack, because every customer below the floor stops seeing packs shipped after the change. Already-published archives are immutable and are never affected by editing this file. Raised 1.0.843 → 1.4.361 on 2026-10-26: the five Sleep-family Formula successors carry the series-formula field `starting_scene_pacing` (the tiered Sleep rhythm, owner decision 2026-10-26), and an older build's strict document schema rejects a pack that carries it. The previously published versions stay installable and untouched.
